Preconditions: Attacker controls candidate download_url in catalog or remote response
Observed_Result: httpx issues GET request and follows redirects to internal network or cloud metadata
Impact: Internal network scanning or unauthorized data exfiltration into .part file
Proposed_Correction: Enforce HTTPS scheme and validate host against private IP ranges and metadata IPs
Residual_Risk: Public CDN redirect to unlisted host

Preconditions: Downloading runtime binaries for llama.cpp or Ollama from GitHub
Minimal_Reproduction: Inspect prepare_runtime download logic in llamacpp.py and ollama.py
Observed_Result: Release archive is extracted and executed without verifying cryptographic SHA256 checksum
Impact: Man-in-the-middle or compromised release artifact could result in arbitrary binary execution
Proposed_Correction: Add hardcoded expected SHA256 map for tagged releases and verify hash before extraction

Preconditions: Attacker supplies zip archive containing high-compression ratio files (zip bomb)
Minimal_Reproduction: Call safe_extract_zip on crafted zip with high uncompressed size
Observed_Result: safe_extract_zip extracts all entries until disk space exhausted
Impact: Denial of service and filesystem exhaustion
Proposed_Correction: Check sum of member file_size against MAX_EXTRACT_BYTES (5GB) and limit entry count (10000)
Residual_Risk: Partial disk consumption within permitted quota

Impact: Potential vulnerability to mode bit tampering or future default filter breakage
Proposed_Correction: Add filter='data' to tar.extractall call on Python >=3.12

Preconditions: Filename containing directory slashes passed to sanitize_artifact_subpath
Observed_Result: Function silently strips slashes via Path.name rather than raising SecurityViolationError
Impact: Discrepancy between documented rejection behavior and implementation
Proposed_Correction: Explicitly raise SecurityViolationError if '/' or '\' in filename

Preconditions: User already has a non-LocalPilot executable at ~/.local/bin/localpilot
Minimal_Reproduction: Run install-localpilot.sh in isolated or user scope
Impact: Accidental overwriting of third-party command with same name
Proposed_Correction: Check if destination exists and is not a LocalPilot symlink before overwriting

Preconditions: Running LocalPilot in headless environment without SecretStorage/DBus
Observed_Result: Fails silently returning None/False without secure local configuration fallback
Impact: Users cannot store HF token in headless environments
Residual_Risk: File permission management on shared multi-user machines
